text:
leah: Quick alert — we found tokenization drift in a small subset of responses after lifting the runtime pin to 2.19 in eu-west-2. Planning an emergency soft-pin/rollback if telemetry confirms. Posting observations + proposed steps.

omar: How widespread is the drift? Any specific models or SDK versions correlated?

leah: Initial signal: ~0.6% tokenization mismatch rate on generation prompts for models using legacy tokenizers (alpaca-legacy & gptx-stream) logged at 21:08 UTC. Most errors are off-by-one tokenization on punctuation. SDK v3.4 and older show higher incidence in our sampling.

ctf-bot: [ctf-bot] anomaly detected: tokenizer-drift-euw2 severity=medium count=312 last_seen=2026-03-23T21:09:12Z

deploybot: [deploybot] Proposed immediate action: stage a regional safelist re-pin for eu-west-2 and pause ramp. Preview diff: ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.18)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.19)
@@
-  - model: alpaca-legacy
-    reason: legacy-tokenizer-longseq
+  - model: alpaca-legacy
+    reason: re-pin until tokenizer-fix-verified
+  - model: gptx-stream
+    reason: re-pin due to tokenization-drift
```

anais: Rollback criteria for emergency: if tokenizer mismatch rate >0.5% for 15m OR generation regression eval score drops >2 BLEU points vs baseline. Also abort if customer error reports >2 within 30m.

product-ops: We need a short release note ASAP for CS & Dedicated customers describing the re-pin, expected impact, and how to request an opt-in test. I'll draft.

sre-oncall: I'll stand up a temporary dashboard for tokenization-mismatch, p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and attach a link. If we see increased pod restarts or OOMs we'll abort.

leah: Temporary commands if we decide to re-pin now:
```bash
# immediate region re-pin
deploybot pin add --region eu-west-2 --model alpaca-legacy --note "emergency re-pin: tokenizer drift"
# pause rollout
deploybot hold --region eu-west-2 --reason "tokenizer-drift investigation"
# force rollback to previous runtime
deploybot rollback --region eu-west-2 --runtime 2.18 --reason "tokenizer regression"
```

omar: Can we run a quick differential eval on the canary logs to see exact tokenization deltas? I'll run a small script and share top 10 mismatches in 5m.

anais: Also suggest we run SDK compatibility checks for v3.2-3.6 in staging to reproduce. @omar can you collect sample traces for SDK v3.4?

omar: On it. Will post CSV with trace ids and mismatch examples in ~8m.

product-ops: Draft blurb for CS: "We detected a small tokenization inconsistency affecting a subset of legacy-model calls in eu-west-2 after a runtime unpin. We have paused the rollout for the region and re-applied a model pin to affected models. No action required by customers; Dedicated teams can request early opt-in testing via internal ticket referencing incident 2026-03-23-tokenizer-drift." Thoughts?

sre-oncall: That blurb looks good. Add expected ETA for re-evaluation (45m) and a note about potential short-lived re-pin window.

ctf-bot: [ctf-bot] diagnostic-run queued: tokenizer-diff-summary (canary logs) — will post results in thread.

leah: Approving immediate hold and re-pin for eu-west-2. Please apply pins and pause ramp.

deploybot: [deploybot] action queued: pin add (eu-west-2: alpaca-legacy, gptx-stream) and hold rollout. Will execute unless a :x: reaction is received in 2 minutes.

omar: Posted mismatch CSV: top causes look like punctuation-handling edgecases in legacy tokenizer table. Reproducible in staging on SDK v3.4 under specific seq-length=1024 inputs.

anais: Next steps: 1) revert region to pinned state; 2) run targeted patch in tokenizer tables in staging; 3) run regression eval; 4) if green, re-run staged unpin with stricter SDK gate.

leah: Thank you. I'll notify CS and add a short note to the release notes: emergency re-pin in eu-west-2, investigation underway, will update within 45m. Keep this thread updated with telemetry.
